title: Queen Liliʻuokalani is overthrown in Hawaii
summary: A group of mostly American businessmen, backed by United States Marines, deposed Queen Liliʻuokalani and set up a provisional government.
reason: Sugar planters opposed the queen's plan for a new constitution restoring royal power and wanted annexation by the United States.
significance: It ended the Hawaiian monarchy and led to annexation by the United States in 1898.
place: ʻIolani Palace, Honolulu, Hawaii, United States
